summary: A polity the Historical Basemaps dataset draws in the snapshots for 1715 and 1815. That dataset is a set of world border snapshots from antiquity to the twentieth century. It is its authors' work in progress, and it asks to be checked against other sources before use. The source calls it "Martinique". The names on this record are the ones data/imports/basemaps-actors.json gives it. The interval on this record is the span those snapshots cover, 1715 to 1877. It says nothing about when this polity began or ended: a snapshot says where a border was drawn for one year, and the years between two of them are assumed. The import wrote this record from those fields, and it asserts nothing the dataset does not.
